:::{#def-symmetric-relation}
#### Symmetric relation

Let $\sim$ be a [relation](functions.qmd#def-relation) on a [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $S$.
The relation $\sim$ is **symmetric**
[@wikipedia_symmetric_relation]
if,
[for all](proof-writing.qmd#def-universal-quantifier) $a, b \in S$,
$a \sim b$ [implies](proof-writing.qmd#def-implies) $b \sim a$.

:::
